adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `update` is a no-op that just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` without persisting anything, so `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` will always return 200 with the current state. On the client side, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({});`, which would hit that endpoint (via the new `admin/adapters/embedding.js.es6`) and appear to “succeed” while doing nothing. However, the provided `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` doesn’t invoke `saveChanges` at all (hosts are saved via `embeddable-host` component / `EmbeddableHostsController`), so this is more an incomplete/unused endpoint + dead action than a currently user-visible broken behavior.
